newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's elects new chairman; set stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's elects new chairman; set stock buyback.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc., the casino operator, said Monday that Philip Satre has been elected to succeed Michael Rose, who is retiring as chairman of the board.
The company also said that its board authorised the repurchase of up to 10 percent of its outstanding common stock. Harrah's has 102.9 million shares outstanding.
Harrah's said it would buy back the shares between now and the end of 1997 in the open market and in private transactions.
Satre, 47, will maintain his position of president and chief executive officer. The appointment is effective Jan. 1, 1997, the company said.
Harrah's stock was up 75 cents at $18.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
